mechanism_narrative: A higher federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) compresses equity valuations by increasing the discount rate for future cash flows, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days. This relationship holds consistently across market conditions.
failure_condition: The correlation between FEDFUNDS and 20-day SPX returns is positive in more than 50% of 3-year rolling windows, or the Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the unemployment rate above 3.5% signals deteriorating labor market conditions, which increases the risk of economic recession and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE > 3.5 over a 3-year rolling window, or the Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and industrial production (INDPRO) below their 12-month moving averages signals a deepening economic contraction, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when both HOUST and INDPRO are below their 12-month moving averages over a 3-year rolling window, or the Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle (defined by a month-over-month increase in FEDFUNDS), the S&P 500 is more sensitive to economic weakness, leading to negative forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS is rising (month-over-month increase) over a 3-year rolling window, or the Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A low level of residential fixed investment (RSAFS) signals weakening housing market conditions, which is a leading indicator of economic slowdown and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The correlation between RSAFS and 20-day SPX returns is positive in more than 50% of 3-year rolling windows, or the Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) above its 12-month moving average signals accelerating inflation, which triggers a market sell-off and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL is above its 12-month moving average over a 3-year rolling window, or the Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below its 12-month moving average signals a weakening economy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO is below its 12-month moving average over a 3-year rolling window, or the Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and residential fixed investment (RSAFS) below their 12-month moving averages signals a deepening housing market crisis, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when both HOUST and RSAFS are below their 12-month moving averages over a 3-year rolling window, or the Rank IC is below 0.03.
